share.title: Sharing my profile with my teacher
share.explain: If you turn sharing on, the teachers assigned to you can read your profile and your suggestions, and can help you with your pathway and applications.
share.point1: If sharing is off, your teacher cannot see your profile.
share.point2: You can turn it off again at any time.
share.point3: Notes a teacher adds to your profile are marked as coming from the teacher.
share.guardianNeeded: You are under 18, so a parent or guardian must agree. Enter their details.
share.agreeSelf: I agree that my teacher can see my profile.
share.agreeGuardian: My parent or guardian agrees that my teacher can see my profile.
share.errName: Please enter the parent or guardian's name.
share.errPhone: Enter a 10-digit mobile number starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9.
share.errAgree: Please tick the box to continue.
